text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Japan Cup. Meisho
Doto
nervously announces herself as a
rival to T.M.
Opera O.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О puts on a shocked front,
but she
inwardly welcomes the change
and gladly accepts
Doto's challenge.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
